messages:
Priya (CTO): Quick follow-up from todays all-hands about the hiring wave and team moves. Drop clarifying q's here; we'll post a short handbook entry after.
Maya (People Ops): Will reply to mobility/process Qs. If you prefer private, DM me.
Jules (SWE): For engineers being moved, do we keep the same IC title and manager during the 2-week shadow?
Maya (People Ops): Default: title and manager remain the same for the transition window. Any manager change will be communicated 1:1 at least 3 business days before the effective date.
Omar (Head of Runtime): We'll run paired handoffs for runbooks and dashboards during the shadow period. Expect a shared checklist in Confluence by EOD tomorrow.
Jules (SWE): Nice. Oncall impact?
Omar (Head of Runtime): Minimal change for product-facing oncall. Runtime will absorb infra-level alerts; well publish the new rota and a pager overlap plan next Tue.
Nina (Recruiter): New reqs posted: REQ-1007 (Runtime Eng), REQ-1008 (Infra SWE), REQ-1012 (Dedicated Ops). Internal referrals: https://intra.redwood/refer.
Jules (SWE): Any change to interview loops or compensation bands for Runtime hires?
Maya (People Ops): Interview loops: added a short system-latency case for Runtime. Compensation bands tied to existing tiers; no immediate band reshuffle.
Finance Bot: Budget note: managers impacted by headcount moves will receive a budget adj memo. Realloc requests handled within 5 business days.
Marco (CEO): Strategic note: this wave is about removing duplicated ownership and speeding iteration, not headcount reduction.
Priya (CTO): OKRs: Product and Eng leads will mark any mid-quarter changes. We plan minimal scope shifts; PMs will post updates if something moves.
Jules (SWE): If I want to apply for an internal role, what's the exact steps?
Maya (People Ops): Fill internal-mobility form, get current manager signoff, and recruiter will fast-track for this wave. Link: https://intra.redwood/internal-move. We're waiving the usual 4-week cool-off for transfers in this cycle.
Priya (CTO): For external comms: contact comms@redwood with a one-paragraph request. Well provide approved language for vendors/customers.
Allhands Bot: Recording + FAQ draft uploaded: https://intra.redwood/all-hands/1748009999/recording :white_check_mark:
Maya (People Ops): Thanks everyone. We'll consolidate this thread into a short FAQ and ownership matrix and drop it here by Fri. DM for anything private.
